mapper.select: select id, source_entity_id, name, url, normalized_url, endpoint_type, connector_type, language, polling_interval_seconds, display_policy, index_policy, authority_override, config::text as config_json, credential_ref, status, health_status, last_success_at, last_failure_at, failure_count, last_probe_status, last_probe_latency_ms, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at from source.source_endpoint where id = #{id}

select s.id, s.name, s.slug, s.entity_type, s.official_level, s.authority_score, s.status as source_status, e.id as endpoint_id, e.name as endpoint_name, e.endpoint_type, e.url as endpoint_url, e.status as endpoint_status, e.health_status, e.last_success_at, e.last_failure_at, e.version as endpoint_version, e.updated_at from source.source_entity s join source.source_endpoint e on e.source_entity_id = s.id where s.id = #{sourceId} order by e.updated_at desc, e.id desc

select count(*) as total_endpoints, count(*) filter (where status = 'ACTIVE') as active_endpoints, count(*) filter (where health_status = 'HEALTHY') as healthy_endpoints, count(*) filter (where health_status in ('WARNING', 'FAILED')) as attention_endpoints from source.source_endpoint where status <> 'ARCHIVED'
mapper.update: update source.source_entity set status = 'ACTIVE', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'DRAFT'

update source.source_endpoint set health_status = #{healthStatus}, last_probe_status = #{httpStatus}, last_probe_latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, last_success_at = case when #{successful} then now() else last_success_at end, last_failure_at = case when #{successful} then last_failure_at else now() end, failure_count = case when #{successful} then 0 else failure_count + 1 end, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
